children.value: The highest linear predictor order is 8; 10 of 10 subframes are linear predictors.

children.name: Evidence
children.value: Every linear predictor has a coefficient precision of 15 bits, the precision every FFmpeg release run wrote in every level fixture of Encspect's tests.

children.name: Evidence
children.value: Levels 5 to 12 set differing highest linear predictor orders, a highest partition order of 8 and a block size of 4,608 samples.

children.name: Evidence
children.value: The frames reach the highest linear predictor order and partition order of the lowest level they fit (the partition order in at least a fifth of the subframes).

children.name: Page
children.value: serial 0x6089D5B5, sequence 2, granule 46080, end of stream

findings.message: STREAMINFO does not say how many samples the stream holds (the count is 0, as an encoder writes it when it cannot seek back); the frames hold 46080.
The MD5 of the audio in STREAMINFO is 0, which means the encoder did not know it; the audio cannot be checked against it.
